data.name: Road Construction Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Plan it, build it, lay it down

In Road Construction Simulator you take full control of road construction, from initial planning to the finished carriageway. Choose the road type, set the location, and draw the route freely on the map. From simple gravel roads to federal highways, you decide what gets built and where.

10 authentic construction vehicles in action

Get behind the wheel of nine different construction vehicles and experience every step of road building up close. Strip the ground with the grader, spread binder with the binder spreader, or lay the final surface with the paver. Dump trucks transport material, while the roller compactor and tandem roller take care of the necessary compaction.

Your company grounds, your signature

On your own company grounds, your vehicles are ready and waiting. Change your work clothes and choose custom colors for your fleet – turning every machine into a piece of you.

Features

  • Road planning

    - Free choice of road type: Renovation, Gravel Road, Farm Road, Country Road, or Federal Highway

    - Freely set and draw the location and route on the map

  • Construction vehicles

    - 10 different construction vehicles: Grader, Binder Spreader, Dump Truck, Excavator, Paver, Marker Machine, Roller Compactor, Tandem Roller, Milling Machine

    - Each vehicle with its own dedicated purpose in the construction process

  • Academy & Sandbox

    - Academy Mode: missions introducing you to the vehicles as well as road renovation, construction, and planning

    - Sandbox Mode: completely free road building with no constraints

  • Personalization

    - Custom work clothing

    - Freely selectable colors for your fleet at your own company grounds
